name: open-ports
title: Open Ports
description: Inspect listening TCP ports and kill the processes behind them
author: tony.nguyen

commands.name: view-open-ports
commands.title: View Open Ports
commands.subtitle: Open Ports
commands.description: Browse all listening TCP ports with the owning process, PID, user, bind address and IP version.

commands.name: kill-listening-process
commands.title: Kill Listening Process
commands.subtitle: Open Ports
commands.description: Kill a process by PID, or pick the port/process to terminate from the list. Supports graceful and force kill.

preferences.name: confirmKill
preferences.title: Safety
preferences.label: Ask for confirmation before killing
preferences.description: Show a confirmation dialog before a process is terminated.

preferences.name: showDetailByDefault
preferences.title: Layout
preferences.label: Show the detail panel by default
preferences.description: Open View Open Ports with the metadata panel already expanded.

preferences.name: defaultSignal
preferences.title: Default Signal
preferences.description: Signal used by the primary kill action. Force kill (SIGKILL) is always available as a secondary action.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
